freeze_before_outcomes: exact OpenML task IDs and official splits
theorem_prediction: binding has value on a positive-mass coarse fibre iff the fibre contains incompatible optimal-action sets; if all states in the fibre share an optimal action, the binding cannot improve optimal expected utility under the registered information surface
required_strata: at least one prospectively predicted no-value/tie stratum
at least one prospectively predicted positive-value stratum
information_matching: All non-oracle arms receive identical raw facts; only the registered binding relation differs where that is the experimental factor.
stop_rule: No task replacement, utility change, binding-coordinate change, or stratum relabel after protected outcomes.
